_comment: Creatures as the world knows them. Each names its 2025 Monster Manual stat block (data/statblocks.json: every number it fights with) and adds its flavour: what the game calls it (name, plural), its body, morale and rank, the names its people use, its gear (loot and pictures), money, loot, what it butchers into, descriptions; game-only traits (takes_food, leader, undead...); attack_extras by action id (the wound it leaves, a disease it carries, the item it strikes with); action_swap (an action the world does not have yet, replaced); override (a number set on purpose). Encounter groups, and who lives in each kind of site, below.

wolf.name: wolf
descriptions: A grey wolf, ribs showing under a winter coat, eyes fixed on your throat.
Lean, yellow-eyed and patient. Where there is one there are always more.

dire_wolf.name: dire wolf
descriptions: A wolf the size of a pony, its muzzle grey with age and old blood.
Too big to be a wolf. It moves like one anyway.

wild_dog.name: wild dog
descriptions: A mangy feral dog, one of a pack gone wild since the villages emptied.

boar.name: wild boar
descriptions: A bristling black boar with tusks like curved knives. Hunters fear them more than wolves.

black_bear.name: black bear
descriptions: A black bear, lean from the winter and short-tempered with it.

brown_bear.name: brown bear
descriptions: A brown bear as tall as a door when it rears, with claws that could take a man's face off.

giant_rat.name: giant rat
descriptions: A rat the size of a dog, bald-tailed and bold, with filth crusted on its teeth.

giant_spider.name: giant spider
descriptions: A spider bigger than a sheep, its eight eyes catching the light like wet pebbles.

bandit.name: bandit
descriptions: A hungry-looking man in a patched jerkin, holding his blade like someone who has used it.
Somebody's son once. Now a knife in a ditch by the road.

bandit_archer.name: bandit archer
descriptions: A lean poacher with a bow, keeping well back from the fighting.

bandit_captain.name: bandit captain
descriptions: The leader: well-armed, well-fed, with rings on fingers that have never ploughed a furrow.

thug.name: thug
descriptions: A big man with a broken nose, a mace and no questions.

deserter.name: deserter
descriptions: A soldier without a banner: rusted mail, a spear, and the look of someone who hasn't eaten in days.
Ran from some lord's war. Now he's more frightened of you than you are of him, and that makes him dangerous.

cultist.name: cultist
descriptions: A villager in a hooded robe, eyes glassy with something that is not quite faith.

cult_fanatic.name: cult fanatic
descriptions: A preacher of something old and hungry, with a voice that carries and hands that burn.

skeleton.name: skeleton
descriptions: Old bones held together by nothing you can see, still wearing the rags of a grave shroud.

zombie.name: zombie
descriptions: A corpse that walks, bloated and grey, stinking of the grave it should still be in.

ghoul.name: ghoul
descriptions: Something that was a man, grown long-limbed and grey on a diet of the dead. Its touch numbs.

gnoll.name: gnoll
descriptions: Hyena-headed, long-limbed, and laughing at nothing. They eat what they kill, and they kill more than they can eat.

hobgoblin.name: hobgoblin
descriptions: Orange-skinned, disciplined, and in proper armour that has been looked after: the worst kind of goblin-kin.

bugbear.name: bugbear
descriptions: Huge, hairy and silent on its feet, which is the part nobody believes until it is too late.

berserker.name: berserker
descriptions: Bare-armed in this weather, eyes on nothing, already moving. They do not stop when they should.

stirge.name: stirge
descriptions: A fist-sized thing of wings and proboscis that drops off the ceiling and does not let go.

goblin.name: goblin
descriptions: A goblin: small, quick, cruel and cowardly, which makes it very good at staying alive.

orc.name: orc
descriptions: An orc raider, tusked and scarred, with an axe that has seen a great deal of use.

ogre.name: ogre
descriptions: Ten feet of stinking muscle with a tree-trunk club and the appetite of a famine.

troll.name: troll
descriptions: A troll: gangling, green-grey and horribly quick, its wounds closing even as you watch.

wight.name: wight
descriptions: A barrow-lord still in its rotted mail, eyes like cold stars. It hates the living, and it remembers how to fight.

goblin_boss.name: goblin boss
descriptions: Bigger than the others, meaner than the others, and wearing somebody's mail shirt.

orc_warchief.name: orc warchief
descriptions: Scarred, tusked and hung with trophies. The others are afraid of it, and they are right to be.

young_dragon.name: young dragon
descriptions: A dragon. Not the oldest or the greatest of them, but the heat of it reaches you from across the cave, and it has already seen you.

commoner.name: commoner
descriptions: An ordinary person, frightened and angry, holding whatever came to hand.

guard.name: guard
descriptions: A town guard in a dented cap and a chain shirt, holding a spear the way you hold a tool you use every day.

acolyte.name: acolyte
descriptions: A priest of the temple, soft-handed, more used to prayers than blows.

noble.name: noble
descriptions: Someone used to being obeyed, and not used to this.

camel.name: camel
descriptions: A hump-backed beast with a long, sour face and a gait like a rocking cart.
It spits and groans, and it has outlived many who rode it.

draft_horse.name: draft horse
descriptions: A great, slow-footed horse, its hooves broad as dinner plates.
Bred to pull a plough or a wagon, and it will lean into anything in its way.

mastiff.name: mastiff
descriptions: A heavy-jawed dog with a scarred muzzle and a low, steady growl.
Kept to guard a door or a flock, and loyal to the last.

mule.name: mule
descriptions: A stubborn grey-brown beast with long ears and a patient, ill-tempered eye.
It carries more than it looks able to, and kicks hard when pushed.

pony.name: pony
descriptions: A shaggy little horse, sure-footed on bad roads.
Small, but it bites and kicks like any other horse.

riding_horse.name: riding horse
descriptions: A lean, long-legged horse bred for the road.
It is quick and nervous, and a fall from its back is a long one.

warhorse.name: warhorse
descriptions: A thick-necked horse trained to hold its ground among blades and blood.
Its hooves can break a man's ribs, and it will charge at a word.

bat.name: bat
descriptions: A palm-sized bat, brown as old leather, folding and unfolding its wings.
It hears you long before it sees you, and answers with a click.

cat.name: cat
descriptions: A lean grey cat with a torn ear, sitting as though the place were hers.
She watches you with half-shut eyes and misses nothing.

crab.name: crab
descriptions: A crab no wider than a fist, its shell crusted with salt and barnacle.
It sidles along on dry land as if the tide were only a little way off.

frog.name: frog
descriptions: A mottled green frog, damp and still, with gold-ringed eyes.
Its throat swells and falls, and it is gone in a single hop when it likes.

hawk.name: hawk
descriptions: A small hawk with a barred breast and a hard yellow eye.
It sees a mouse move at a hundred paces and does not blink.

lizard.name: lizard
descriptions: A dry-skinned lizard the colour of the wall it clings to.
It sits in the sun, throat pulsing, and watches without moving.

owl.name: owl
descriptions: A round-faced owl, feathers the colour of bark, turning its head to follow every sound.
It flies without a whisper, and the dark does not trouble it.

rat.name: rat
descriptions: A sleek brown rat with a pink tail and quick, clever whiskers.
It has lived in worse places than this and means to live in more.

raven.name: raven
descriptions: A raven glossy as wet tar, head tilted, one bright eye on you.
It croaks a scrap of speech it has stolen from somebody and does not say whose.

scorpion.name: scorpion
descriptions: A pale scorpion no longer than a thumb, its tail curled over its back.
It keeps to the shade of stones and does not run from anything.

spider.name: spider
descriptions: A small black spider, long-legged, hanging from a thread you cannot see.
It crosses a web as if the strands were a road it had walked all its life.

weasel.name: weasel
descriptions: A long, russet weasel, thin as a sock, with a white throat.
It pours itself through any gap and is out of sight before you move.

town_watch.name: the town watch
intro: "Watch! Stand where you are!"
Boots behind you, and a hand on your shoulder. "You. A word."
The watch comes round the corner four abreast and stops when they see you.

angry_townsfolk.name: angry townsfolk
intro: They come at you, shouting.
A crowd has decided something about you, and it has decided fast.
Someone points, someone shouts your name, and the street empties towards you.

lone_wolf.name: a lone wolf
intro: A wolf breaks from the trees and comes at you low and fast.
A wolf has been following you for a mile. It has stopped following.
One wolf, alone and thin, steps into the road and will not give it up.

wolf_pack.name: a pack of wolves
intro: Wolves: grey shapes on either side of you, and one more behind.
A howl, close. Then another, closer. The pack has found you.
The horses would be screaming, if you had horses. Wolves, and they have chosen their ground.
You count four before you stop counting.

dire_wolves.name: dire wolves
intro: Wolves as big as ponies step out of the dark and do not hurry.
Something the size of a horse moves at the edge of the trees, and then a second one does.
They come at a walk, which is worse than a run: they are in no doubt.

guard_dogs.name: guard dogs
intro: Somewhere a chain rattles loose, and then there are dogs coming across the dark field, low and silent.
A farmer's mastiffs, let off the chain for the night, and you are on their ground.
Big-headed dogs with spiked collars come out of the dark between you and the road, and they do not bark.

wild_dogs.name: wild dogs
intro: A pack of starving dogs, ribs like fingers, circles you and closes in.
The dogs have been eating something they should not have, and they want more of it.
A dozen dogs, half wild, cut off the road behind and in front.

boar.name: a wild boar
intro: The undergrowth explodes and a boar charges straight at you.
A boar, old and scarred, plants itself in the path and lowers its head.
You hear it before you see it, and then there is no time for seeing.

bear.name: a bear
intro: A bear rises from a thicket not ten yards off, and it does not like you.
A bear stands up out of the bracken and looks down at you.
The bear is between you and the way out, and it knows it.

brown_bear.name: a brown bear
intro: A brown bear, huge and hungry after winter, comes at you from the rocks.
A brown bear with cubs somewhere behind it. That is the worst kind.
It comes down off the rocks in three strides and none of them are slow.

rats.name: giant rats
intro: Red eyes in the dark, and the chitter of something far too big to be a rat.
The floor moves. All of it.
Something squeals, and the dark answers with a hundred squeals.

footpads.name: footpads
intro: Two men step out onto the road ahead, blades drawn. 'Your purse, and nobody gets hurt.'
A voice from the hedge: "Stand still, and it stays friendly."
Two of them, nervous and armed, which is the dangerous combination.

bandits.name: bandits
intro: Bandits: men with the look of hunger and practice, spreading out to block the road.
A crossbow bolt thuds into a tree beside your head. Then the bandits come.
They have felled a tree across the road, and they are waiting beside it.
Men rise out of the ditch on both sides of the road. This was arranged.

bandit_gang.name: a bandit gang
intro: A whole gang, with a captain in good leather giving the orders. They have done this many times before.
A dozen of them, and a captain who counts you first and draws second.
The whole gang, blocking the road at its narrowest, at their leisure.

thugs.name: hired thugs
intro: Two big men who have clearly been paid to do something unpleasant, and have decided it will be you.
"Nothing personal," says the bigger one, rolling his shoulder.
Two men who have been waiting a while, and are annoyed about the wait.

deserters.name: deserters
intro: Soldiers without a banner, hollow-cheeked, spears levelled. They look more desperate than cruel.
Men in the rags of a uniform, and they have not eaten today either.
They hold their spears like men who were taught properly and have stopped caring.

cultists.name: cultists
intro: Hooded figures around a fire that shouldn't be burning out here. They turn as one.
Robed figures kneeling round something on the ground. They stand up together.
A smell of burnt hair, a mutter of the same words over and over, and then silence as they see you.

cult_circle.name: a cult circle
intro: A ring of chanting figures, and at its heart a preacher whose hands smoke.
The chanting rises, and something in the middle of the circle answers it.
Candles in a ring, faces above them, and the preacher smiling at you.

restless_dead.name: the restless dead
intro: Bones rattle in the dark. Something that should be buried is walking toward you.
The barrow mouth is open, and what came out of it is still coming.
Dry bone on stone, from everywhere at once.

zombies.name: walking corpses
intro: The smell reaches you first: the grave, opened. Then they come shambling.
They come out of the mist at a walk, and they do not stop walking.
One of them is wearing what is left of a carter's coat.

ghouls.name: ghouls
intro: Grey things, long-armed, loping on all fours: ghouls, and they have smelt your blood.
Something is eating, and it has heard you, and it is no longer eating.
Long grey fingers, and a mouth that opens further than a mouth should.

gnoll_pack.name: a gnoll pack
intro: Laughter that is not laughter, from three directions at once, and then they come.
A hyena laugh, and behind it the sound of something running on two legs.
They have a pole with heads on it, and they are proud of it.

hobgoblin_patrol.name: a hobgoblin patrol
intro: They come down the road in step, in armour, and they have already seen you.
A horn goes once, sharp, and the shields come up in a line.
Armour, discipline and no discussion: a patrol, and you are in its way.

bugbear_ambush.name: bugbears
intro: The undergrowth stands up, and it is holding a morningstar.
The first you know of it is the weight of something landing behind you.
A bugbear steps out grinning, and two more come out of the trees behind you.

berserkers.name: berserkers
intro: Men in furs and less, coming at a run, shouting one word over and over.
They have thrown away their shields somewhere back there, and are the happier for it.
Bare arms, painted faces, and a noise that is not a war cry so much as a laugh.

stirges.name: stirges
intro: Something drops out of the dark on leather wings, and then a dozen more do.
A cloud comes off the rocks and turns towards the warmth of you.
Wings, and a needle going into your neck before you have understood it.

goblins.name: goblins
intro: Goblins pour out of a gully, shrieking and waving blades.
Goblins, and they have a plan, and it is a bad one but there are a lot of them.
Small, fast, filthy, and coming from three directions.

orc_raiders.name: orc raiders
intro: Orc raiders, tusked and painted, coming at a run with axes raised.
They have been burning something, and the smoke is still on them.
A raiding party, unhurried, spreading out to take you from the sides.

ogre.name: an ogre
intro: The ground shakes. An ogre, ten feet of stink and appetite, has seen you.
Something has been eating cattle out here, and it is still hungry.
An ogre with a tree for a club, and it has already picked you up with its eyes.

troll.name: a troll
intro: A troll. You have heard the stories. They are all true, and it is already running.
The stink reaches you first. Then the long arms.
It unfolds itself off the rock face, and keeps unfolding.

spiders.name: giant spiders
intro: Webs between the trees, thick as rope, and something heavy moving along them.
The web takes you across the face, and something starts down the strand towards you.
Bundles hang in the branches, and some of them are man-sized.

barrow_wight.name: the barrow's lord
intro: In the deepest chamber something in rotted mail rises from its bier, and the dead around it rise too.
Cold comes into the chamber ahead of it, and the torches go blue.
The thing on the bier turns its head, and what is left of a crown slips.

goblin_warband.name: a goblin warband
intro: The warren's chief, and all its kin, screaming.
Every goblin in the place, and the chief behind them shouting.
The warren empties into the chamber: there is no counting them.

orc_warband.name: an orc warband
intro: The warchief stands, and its guards close around it.
Drums, and then the warchief's guards fill the passage.
The whole band on its feet at once, and the chief already coming for you.

cult_temple.name: the cult's inner circle
intro: The chanting stops. Every hooded face turns to you.
The preacher raises both hands, and everything in the temple looks up.
They were waiting for you, and they have been told your name.

bandit_hideout.name: the outlaws' captain
intro: The captain kicks over the table and draws. "Nobody leaves."
"Well," says the captain, standing slowly. "That saves us finding you."
The fire is lit, the table is laid, and every man in the room reaches for a weapon.

dragon.name: the dragon
intro: Gold, a mountain of it. And on the gold, the dragon.
The heat comes first, and then an eye the size of a shield opens.
The hoard shifts, and what you took for a wall of bronze breathes in.
